audience: event organizers who sell tickets with TicketSpice and want answers about sales and attendees

useCases.title: Check ticket sales and revenue for an event
useCases.text: The AI lists your events, then pulls the sold tickets and the payment transactions of one of them. You see how many tickets sold and the money taken, including refunds.

useCases.title: Build an attendee list with check-in status
useCases.text: The AI lists the sold tickets of an event with buyer name, ticket level, scan count and last scan time. You see who has arrived and who has not.

useCases.title: Find everything one buyer purchased
useCases.text: Give an email address and the AI finds the matching customer, their orders and their tickets. It helps when a buyer asks what they bought.

useCases.title: See how much limited inventory is left
useCases.text: The AI reads the inventory items of an event with sold and remaining quantities. You see which limited tickets or add-ons are close to selling out.

useCases.title: Review the coupons of an event
useCases.text: The AI lists the coupons of one event or of the whole account with discounts, codes, expiry and how often each was redeemed.

useCases.title: Create or remove a discount coupon
useCases.text: The AI creates a percent or fixed-amount coupon with your codes, use limit and expiry. It can also delete a coupon after showing it to you and getting your approval.
